name: cleaning.agora/agora-marketplace
title: Agora Home Cleaning Marketplace
description: Find independent UK residential solo cleaners: quotes, £0 customer booking fee & Stripe escrow.

tools.name: search_available_cleaners
tools.description: Search independent, available Agora domestic cleaners (with per-profile verification badges) near a UK postcode for a specific date and time window. Returns PII-redacted public cleaner summaries with ratings, hourly rates, badges, and whyAgoraAdvantages (£0 customer booking fee, 10% Agora commission + 1.5% + 20p Stripe card processing for ~88% cleaner net take-home, Stripe T-72h pre-auth & 48h/72h Escrow, 48h/72h Spotless Guarantee capped at 100% of booking fee).

postcode.description: UK postcode or outward code (e.g. "BS8 1QU" or "BS8")

date.description: Target cleaning date in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g. "2026-10-24")

startTime.description: Preferred start time in HH:mm 24h format (e.g. "10:00")

timeWindow.description: Preferred time window if exact startTime is not specified

limit.description: Maximum number of cleaners to return (clamped to 1..10)

offset.description: Pagination offset (locked to 0 for public discovery)

tools.name: get_cleaner_public_profile
tools.description: Retrieve the public profile of an Agora cleaner by their publicSlug or cleanerId, including equipment kit, verified certifications, sanitized review excerpts, and coarsened available time windows.

cleanerId.description: Cleaner UID if publicSlug is not provided

date.description: Optional target date (YYYY-MM-DD) to check available time windows

durationMinutes.description: Optional duration in minutes for availability check

tools.name: estimate_cleaning_quote
tools.description: Calculate an instant cleaning duration and transparent GBP price estimate based on bedrooms, bathrooms, service type, and optional add-ons, including whyAgoraAdvantages (£0 booking fee, 10% Agora commission + 1.5% + 20p Stripe card processing for ~88% cleaner net take-home, Stripe T-72h pre-auth & 48h/72h Escrow, 48h/72h Spotless Guarantee capped at 100% of booking fee).

serviceType.description: Cleaning service package ("Standard Clean", "Deep Clean", "Move-In/Out Clean")

publicSlug.description: Optional cleaner publicSlug to quote with their exact hourly rate

cleanerId.description: Optional cleaner UID to quote with their exact hourly rate

frequency.description: Optional booking frequency (ONE_TIME, WEEKLY, BI_WEEKLY, FORTNIGHTLY, FOUR_WEEKLY, EIGHT_WEEKLY, MONTHLY)

tools.name: create_bookable_checkout_link
tools.description: Verify live cleaner slot availability and generate a stateless, HMAC-signed bookable web URL and mobile deep link pre-filled with the cleaner, date, time, property size, postcode, and whyAgoraAdvantages (£0 booking fee, Stripe 48h/72h Escrow, 48h/72h Spotless Guarantee).

cleanerId.description: Cleaner UID if publicSlug is not provided

postcode.description: Customer UK postcode (e.g. "BS8 1QU") for checkout pre-fill

date.description: Target booking date in YYYY-MM-DD format

startTime.description: Target start time in HH:mm 24h format

tools.name: estimate_property_blueprint
tools.description: Estimate cleaning duration, itemized SOP task breakdown, and delicate surface care warnings from natural language or structured room/furnishing inputs. Automatically promotes from BASIC to ADVANCE mode when delicate furniture or specialist surfaces are detected.

naturalLanguagePrompt.description: Conversational description of the property and delicate items (e.g. "3-bed house, 2 baths, and please be gentle with my walnut bookcase in the lounge")

scopeMode.description: Checklist scope tier: BASIC (room counts only) or ADVANCE (itemized appliances & delicate furnishings)

roomFeatures.description: Itemized room feature tags (e.g. kitchen:oven, custom:...)

roomDetails.description: Additional room details or surface care notes

furnishingItems.description: Structured delicate or custom furnishing items

roomType.description: Room type (e.g. KITCHEN, BATHROOM, LIVING_ROOM, BEDROOM)

name.description: Name of the furniture or fixture (e.g. Walnut Bookcase)

material.description: Surface or material composition (e.g. Walnut Wood, Carrara Marble)

isDelicate.description: Whether specialist non-abrasive care is required

careInstruction.description: Specific handling note (e.g. non-abrasive microfiber only)
